latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Video Easy — fast, free AI-powered video editing from raw footage to polished MP4.

- Instantly edit, trim, or enhance up to 2-minute videos with simple text instructions — no timeline or export settings needed.
- Anonymous users receive a free 7-day token with 100 credits for video processing on sign-up.
- Supports quick exports (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, GIF, JPG, audio formats) with 30–90s cloud processing via GPU.
- Intelligent intent routing: auto-detects user actions like export, credits, upload, and more from chat.
- All-backend errors and status updates auto-translated into helpful feedback; no technical jargon for users.
- Iterative drafts, batch uploads, and timeline refinements supported within a session.
